rawContent: We've been hearing a lot about skills shortages, but here's a category that hasn't been much in the conversation and should be. A @UTSISF @CSIRO survey of the finance sector has found there's currently a #climate #skills gap and that gap is likely to grow: https://t.co/UB6PkM6Y4y

While there's an influx of money into #climate-conscious development, known generally as #greenfinance, not enough people have the specialist #skills needed in the field according to a @UTSISF @CSIRO report, story via @pvmagazineoz: https://t.co/b4yDbWvZlt
